entries.deliverables: Web app · Marketing graphics · Landing page
description: Led UX research for a health-financing web app targeting MSMEs and individual policyholders in Kenya.
Designed accessible onboarding flows, marketing assets, and a product landing page from discovery to high-fidelity prototype.
Coordinated with clinical and engineering stakeholders to translate compliance constraints into usable product flows.
Designed referral, onboarding, and transaction flows for a B2B fintech app serving Kenyan micro and small enterprises.
Led Kiswahili localisation, cutting cognitive load for non-English-dominant users and improving usability test completion rates.
Maintained a Figma component library and produced marketing graphics across a 3-year engagement.
Designed end-to-end UI/UX for a Congolese ride-hailing app, covering separate driver and passenger journeys.
Built a design system optimised for low-bandwidth conditions and entry-level Android devices.
Unified two distinct user mental models — driver and passenger — within a single navigation structure.
Designed and built a landing page for a Kenyan charity platform focused on grassroots community impact.
Prototyped an AI-powered e-learning platform under timed, competitive conditions for a global UX hiring assessment.
Applied end-to-end UX methodology — research synthesis, IA, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping — within a constrained timeline.

entries.deliverables: Machine learning model · Exploratory analysis · Species predictions
description: Built a Random Forest classifier predicting IUCN Red List threat status for Kenya's 335 Data Deficient species, trained on 35,000+ global records.
Managed end-to-end data pipeline: wrangling 8 IUCN CSV sources, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, and SMOTE for class imbalance.
Achieved 87.5% test accuracy and 90.1% cross-validated F1 score; delivered predictions as a conservation research prioritisation tool.
Built an interactive Tableau dashboard exploring Kenya Power electricity pricing, affordability, and the renewable energy transition.
Synthesised government tariff schedules, household income data, and regional generation statistics into a single exploratory tool.
Delivered editorial design work for the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat).
Laid out a position paper for the UNFCCC High-Level Champions — the official champions of the Paris Agreement.
Designed the Inclusive Africa Conference booklet for inABLE, Kenya's leading assistive technology and disability advocacy organisation.
Designed the official event report for the Children & Youth Pavilion at COP27, commissioned by CIFF.
Rebranded and produced event graphics for YOUNGO's annual Local Conference of Youth on Climate Change in Kenya.

entries.client: African Youth Conference on Climate Change (AFRIYOCCC)
description: Designed the attendee resource pack and conference programme for the African Youth Conference on Climate Change.
Laid out a 300-page collaborative research publication for the Kenya Energy Atlas, a joint SID–government initiative.
Managed complex layouts integrating maps, charts, and long-form academic text across multiple thematic chapters.
Designed a property catalogue for a green-living residential development in Parklands, Nairobi.
Designed graphics for the Embassy of Antigua and Barbuda.
Developed brand identity for a healthcare lab management and owner networking platform.
Designed brand identity for an SME point-of-sale SaaS product.
Created brand identity for a luxury residential real estate company in Nairobi.

entries.deliverables: Branding · Social media templates · Product design
description: Built full brand identity, social media templates, and product packaging design for a Kenyan brass jewellery brand.
Created social media graphics and managed digital content for a Nairobi-based garden centre.
